items.name: Proposal Document Completeness Checker
items.description: Uploads a proposal package (VERAS upload bundle, NSF or NIH proposal, plus the relevant solicitation) and returns a single structured JSON gap- analysis covering: senior key personnel, budget personnel, subaward presence, the four per-person required documents (biosketch, current & pending, collaboration & affiliation, synergistic activities), conditional requirements (mentoring plan when postdocs / letter of collaboration for TTP-P / etc.), and a prioritized list of missing items the analyst should ask the PI about. Output conforms to the proposal-document-completeness-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping proposal-document-completeness workflow (two parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt).

data.name: extract-proposal-components
data.prompt:
You are extracting the as-found inventory from a proposal
package. Identify all senior key personnel, budget personnel,
subaward presence, and the per-person document matrix
covering biosketch, current & pending, collaboration &
affiliation, and synergistic activities.

Be 100% accurate. Only emit a person, document, or subaward
when it is observable in the package; never invent. When a
field is not present, set it to null or — for arrays — return
an empty array.

Boolean flags must be derived from observable signals:
has_postdocs_or_grad_students is true only when the budget
actually lists a postdoc or graduate-student line;
has_subawards is true only when a subaward commitment form,
subaward budget, or subaward narrative is present.

Search Section 2 (Personnel), Section 8 (Subawards), Section
9.2 (Budget), Senior Key Personnel listings, and the proposal
document inventory.

data.name: extract-sponsor-requirements
data.prompt:
You are extracting the sponsor-required document set from the
solicitation (RFA / FOA / NOFO) and agency policy (NSF PAPPG,
NIH GPS, etc.). Identify every document the sponsor requires,
every document that is conditionally required, the per-person
required-document set, and the per-subawardee required-document
set.

Be 100% accurate. Only emit a requirement when the sponsor
document or agency policy actually states it; never invent
requirements.

items.searchphrase: Review pathway (7-day basic review, 10-day full review, or Not specified).
items.title: review_type

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {document_name, required_for, notes} for every document the sponsor requires for this proposal. The Consolidation Prompt sets the present boolean.
items.title: required_documents_checklist

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {condition, document_name, notes} for documents required only when a condition holds (e.g., mentoring plan when postdocs present, letter of collaboration for TTP-P track).
items.title: conditional_requirements

items.searchphrase: Document names required per senior-key person (typically biosketch, current & pending, collaboration & affiliation, synergistic activities).
items.title: per_person_required_documents

items.searchphrase: Document names required per subawardee (commitment form, budget, budget justification, senior key docs, scope of work, facilities/equipment).
items.title: subaward_required_documents

data.name: proposal-document-completeness-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the Proposal Document Completeness gap
analysis. The input is the JSON fragment produced by the
upstream parallel Extraction tasks (proposal components +
sponsor requirements). Your job is to emit a single JSON object
that validates against the
proposal-document-completeness-udm@0.1.0 schema.

Rules:
1. Pass-through: sponsor_name, rfa_foa_number,
   proposal_track_type, review_type, senior_key_personnel,
   budget_personnel, has_postdocs_or_grad_students,
   has_subawards, uploaded_documents,
   per_person_required_documents, subaward_required_documents.
2. required_documents_checklist: for each entry produced by
   extract-sponsor-requirements, set the present boolean by
   checking whether a matching document name appears in
   uploaded_documents.
3. conditional_requirements: for each entry, set triggered
   based on observable signals (mentoring plan triggered when
   has_postdocs_or_grad_students; TTP-P letter-of-
   collaboration triggered when proposal_track_type contains
   "TTP"; etc.).
4. per_person_document_matrix: one row per senior_key_personnel
   entry. Set the four document booleans by checking whether a
   document of that type exists in uploaded_documents matching
   that person's name. The missing field is the list of
   false-valued document names.
5. subaward_documents: when has_subawards is false, return an
   empty array. Otherwise produce one row per subawardee with
   the six document booleans and a missing list.
6. personnel_discrepancies: pass through any items from the
   upstream extractor and add any newly observed mismatches
   between budget_personnel and senior_key_personnel names.
7. prioritized_missing: rank the missing items in this order:
   (a) compliance-critical items the sponsor will reject the
   proposal for, (b) per-person required documents (one entry
   per missing per-person document), (c) conditional
   documents whose condition is triggered, (d) optional
   improvements. Do not include items that are present.
8. Use null for missing scalar fields; never invent values.
9. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: Every named senior-key person must appear in both senior_key_personnel and per_person_document_matrix; every budget personnel name must reconcile to a senior_key_personnel row or appear in personnel_discrepancies.
Every document declared required by the sponsor must appear in required_documents_checklist with a present/missing flag.
Each per_person_document_matrix row's missing list must equal the set of false-valued document booleans for that row.
